citations.quote: an allen Fensterrahmen wächst Schimmel, im Schlafzimmer inzwischen schwarz und grossflächig.
An der Heizung liegt es nicht, die läuft gut, die Räume sind warm.
Bevor ich die Novembermiete dorthin überweise statt an die Immo Jura, möchte ich aber von Ihnen wissen, ob ich vorher noch etwas Schriftliches an die Verwaltung schicken muss.

plan.because: Needed to establish the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The original report is needed to establish what was reported to the landlord and when.
Evidence is needed of whether and when the landlord received the defect report.
Dated images are needed to document the affected locations and visible condition.
Request the June response and any subsequent correspondence about work or access.
Mould is reported; dated moisture and temperature observations are relevant.
The customer reports that the heating works and the rooms are warm.
Health effects are unmentioned and presumed absent for the evidence plan.
A need for a specialist is unmentioned and presumed absent for the evidence plan. The cause remains open.
A rent deposit is being considered. Request any deadline already communicated, including its recipient and contents; do not assume one was sent.
This document is optional under the process.

questions: When did the condensation and mould begin, and when and how did you notify the landlord?
Have you already given the landlord a written repair deadline? If so, when and how was it delivered?
Are there any immediate health or safety concerns? If so, please seek appropriate urgent advice.
